candidates.statement: Redis reserve_inventory operations time out (~2s) in inventory, causing inventory POST /v1/reservations to return 503 and propagating ReadTimeout/502 failures up through order and gateway checkout.
candidates.uncertainty: No Redis-side metrics or logs admitted; root cause of the Redis timeouts (saturation, network, config) is not established.

report.explanation: Traces show redis.reserve_inventory timing out with DependencyUnavailable, inventory returning 503, and order/gateway returning 502 ReadTimeout across multiple correlation IDs. Metrics show /v1/checkout 502s and p95 ~2406ms. Topology confirms gateway->order->inventory->redis path. Bounded to redis-timeout; underlying Redis cause unproven.
